```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(glmm)
library(broom)
library(rlist)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtext)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```


```{r}
cytokines <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/cytokines_avg-results.csv")
samplabs <- read.csv("/Users/baileyconrad/Desktop/bewell/data/derived/timepoint_key.csv")
```

Converting data into wide format from long format. 
```{r}
cytokines %>% select(-X) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cytokine, values_from = avg.res)
```


```{r}
samplab.form <- samplabs %>%
  select(Subject.Number, placebo) %>%
  mutate(preP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 1, 3), #quote bc exact string #==; is equal to operator #true = 1, false =3
         postP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 2, 4), 
         preBRB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 3, 1),
        postBRB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 4, 2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "timepoint.label", values_to = "timepoints", cols = c("preP", "postP", "preBRB", "postBRB")) %>%
  mutate(Sample = paste0(Subject.Number, "-", timepoints)) %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint.label) 


cyto.form <- cytokines %>%
 select(-X) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cytokine, values_from = avg.res) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("^0", "", Sample), Sample = gsub("\\.1$", "", Sample)) %>%
  left_join(samplab.form) %>%
  mutate(berry.group = ifelse(grepl("postBRB",timepoint.label), 1, 0))
```

```{r}
object <- c("ALCAM.CD166", "C.Reactive.Protein.CRP", "CCL2.JE.MCP.1", "Complement.Component.C9", "Cystatin.C", "IL.1.beta.IL.1F2", "IL.10", "IL.12.IL.23.p40", "IL.6", "MMP.2", "S100A9", "TNF.alpha", "vWF.A2")

capture.models.univ <- function(outcome, lfun, cytos, modin) {
  mods.list <- lapply(cytos, function(x)  try({glm(as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ ", x)), family = lfun, data = modin) %>% tidy()}))
  
mods.list.clean <- list.clean(mods.list, function(x) is.null(x))
mods.df <- bind_rows(mods.list.clean)
return(mods.df)
}
```


```{r warning=FALSE}
plot <- capture.models.univ(outcome = "berry.group", lfun = "binomial", cytos = object, modin = cyto.form) %>%
  filter(p.value<1.0) %>%
  filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>%
  # mutate(term = fct_reorder(term, estimate)) %>%
  mutate(pointlabs = ifelse(-log(p.value) > 0.5, term, NA)) %>%
  
ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = -log(p.value), label = pointlabs, color = term)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  labs(x = "Estimate", y = "-log(p-value)") 


```

```{r}
plot +
  geom_label_repel() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  # ggtitle("Effect Size of Cytokines in Current and Former Smokers") +
  # theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")

ggsave("../figures/cytokine_effect-size_volcano-plot.png")
```
